"""Reproduce: aggregate over a window-function annotation.

Mirrors the ticket:
    qs.annotate(cumul=Window(Sum("salary"), order_by=F("date").asc()))
    qs.aggregate(total=Sum("salary"), cumul_total=Sum("cumul"))
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={
        "default": {
            "ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3",
            "NAME": ":memory:",
        }
    },
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connection, models  # noqa: E402


class Employee(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=30)
    salary = models.IntegerField(null=True)
    date = models.DateField(null=True)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Employee)

Employee.objects.bulk_create(
    [
        Employee(name="a", salary=10, date="2023-01-01"),
        Employee(name="b", salary=20, date="2023-01-02"),
        Employee(name="c", salary=30, date="2023-01-03"),
    ]
)

from django.db.models import F, Sum, Window  # noqa: E402

queryset = Employee.objects.annotate(
    cumul_DJR=Window(Sum("salary"), order_by=F("date").asc())
)
print("SQL of annotated qs:", queryset.query)

aggregate = queryset.aggregate(
    DJR_total=Sum("salary"),
    cumul_DJR_total=Sum("cumul_DJR"),
)
print("RESULT:", aggregate)
